hardware_label: Measured on 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (laptop-full); not a Raspberry Pi, not embedded hardware

verdicts.question: Did the pipeline meet the 100 ms deadline?
verdicts.statement: No. 100.0 % of 888 frames missed 100 ms. Median latency 518 ms is 5.2x the deadline; P99 is 794 ms.
verdicts.rule: pass: 0 violations; warn: 0 < violations <= 5 %; fail: violations > 5 %. Violation = per-frame pipeline latency (preprocess + register) strictly greater than the deadline.

verdicts.question: Did registration produce valid matches?
verdicts.statement: 299 of 299 registrations passed the validity gate (100.0 %).
verdicts.rule: pass: >= 99 % accepted; warn: >= 90 %; fail: < 90 %. Accepted = passes the registration validity gate.

verdicts.question: How accurate was the estimated trajectory?
verdicts.statement: ATE RMSE 0.15 m (max 0.42 m) over 45.6 m of ground-truth path after rigid alignment; position RPE is reported per window in the summary. Scan-to-scan odometry has no loop closure, so error accumulates with distance.
verdicts.rule: descriptive; no pass/fail threshold is applied to accuracy

verdicts.question: Does this result describe the OS1-64?
verdicts.statement: No. This dataset uses a different sensor (Hesai QT64 (64 beams) - DIFFERENT from OS1-64 (beam layout, FOV, range)); do not read it as an OS1-64 result.
